inference_design.rule: adjusted_p < alpha; exact test required; output and point-gain gates still apply
inference_design.scope: best-case resolution only, not statistical power or a promise of support

measurement_basis.latency: handler await including request trace; excludes its own output check
measurement_basis.worker_cycle: handler plus synchronous output check, excluding the outer worker scheduling loop
measurement_basis.wall: all workers, output checks and orchestration; excludes workload setup, warmup and teardown
measurement_basis.interference: output checks can change request pacing and delay other tasks even when outside the current request timer

evidence_policy.scope: exploratory within-workload support; not preregistered confirmation or a lower bound on the practical margin
evidence_policy.monte_carlo_classification: approximate p-values are reported but never classified as supported

method: randomized paired closed-loop blocks; percentile bootstrap over block mean differences
limitations: cooperative readiness delay does not simulate CPU work
delay sensitivity is not inverse speedup prediction
output hash agreement on tested inputs does not prove semantic equivalence
p95 changes are descriptive; no inferential tail-latency claim
replacement p-values use Holm; all conclusions remain exploratory and workload-specific
synchronous output checks affect closed-loop pacing and may delay other concurrent requests
explicitly instrumented parent spans are not a complete await/dependency graph
